thread:
Maya (CSE): FYI AcmeApp is hitting lots of 429s during SDK init in staging after enabling parallel workers. They reported ~60 parallel connections and ~200ms spikes. Logs attached in thread below.
AcmeApp (engineer): repro steps: start 60 node worker processes -> each calls sdk.init() -> ~10-30% of inits return 429 within first 30s. No token rotation yet.
Eli (Support): can you paste exact error payload? 429 with Retry-After?
AcmeApp (engineer): here —
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "rate_limited",
  "message": "preflight limit exceeded",
  "retry_after": 1
}
```
Maya (CSE): they are using browser SDK in a serverless warmup pattern (many cold workers calling init concurrently).
Arjun (Dev): likely a preflight stampede + ephemeral token fanout. Two quick mitigations: 1) client jittered backoff for init, 2) enable long-lived connection reuse / keepalive so init is cheaper.
Sam (Platform): sxn: suggest setting SDK option connPool: true and preflightCoalesce: 100ms on their side. Also recommend ephemeral token leaky-bucket on auth service.
Eli (Support): @AcmeApp try this quick client change and repro: add randomized delay between 0-250ms before first init, and set http2 keepalive: true. Small patch reduces failures in our internal repro.
AcmeApp (engineer): ok will try. quick question — is there a server-side knob we can tune from Redwood?
Maya (CSE): we can temporarily bump preflight concurrency threshold for their account to avoid immediate failures while they patch client. Want me to request that?
Sam (Platform): yes please — create a short-lived override (30m window) on their account and enable preflight batching on edge route. I'll coordinate rollback after patch. :thumbsup:
onboard-bot: rate-report job scheduled for account acmeapp at 1812350000 — will return per-route preflight metrics.
Arjun (Dev): followup: add token refresh splay (random <= 1s) on startup and reuse token across worker forks where possible. If they use ephemeral per-worker, exponential backoff on 429 with cap=10s.
Eli (Support): assigning myself to monitor. @Maya can you confirm when they push the client change and I'll watch the rate-report?
Maya (CSE): confirmed — ping me when done. I'll also capture their onboarding health and flag renewal risk if they hit production-level failures after GA.
AcmeApp (engineer): patched client with 0-250ms jitter + keepalive, re-ran repro. Initial run: 2/200 inits 429 -> down from 30%. sending new logs.
Eli (Support): nice. I'm seeing reduced 429s in our telemetry. I'll leave the temporary override for another 20m and then revert if stable.
Maya (CSE): nice progress — I'll update the onboarding doc with the mitigation steps (jitter, connPool, keepalive, token splay). Good job team. :raised_hands:
Sam (Platform): notes for product: we should add a short onboarding checklist for serverless warmups + SDK examples to show connPool and preflight coalesce settings. Filing follow-up ticket.
Arjun (Dev): adding sample snippet for docs: 
```
// client init example
await sleep(random(0,250));
const sdk = new RedwoodSDK({ connPool: true, preflightCoalesce: 100, keepAlive: true });
await sdk.init();
```
Maya (CSE): closing this thread after we confirm metrics stable. If 429s resurge, we'll escalate to infra and open a formal incident.
Eli (Support): monitoring — will post final report at 1812350300.
onboard-bot: rate-report complete - preflight success rate improved from 72% -> 98% during window.
